title: passages.json
description: Input file for scripts/holdout_split.py. A list of qualifying passage IDs to split into kept and masked sets for the held-out projection test. Three forms are accepted: a bare array of ids, a wrapped object, or — to enable --stratify — ids carrying a domain label, either as an id→domain mapping or as an array of objects. At least 4 ids are required; below that no meaningful set can be held out. Prefer a labelled form: random masking over an uneven corpus concentrates the mask in the largest domain, and the resulting score then gets read as though it described the whole persona.

additionalProperties.description: Topic domain, matching a name in coverage_map.json's `domains`. Passages sharing a domain are sampled together under --stratify.

clusters.description: Optional provenance, ignored by the script.

id.description: A stable passage id, e.g. 'p001'. Passage ids are yours to assign during Stage 1; keep them stable so the split stays auditable across runs.
